verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a single API that runs the whole flow. Search returns clean page content in one request, with contents features included in search at no extra charge. Exa Agent and deep search do iterative search, reasoning and grounded synthesis with citations, alongside answer() with citations and async deep research, all agent-accessible via SDK and MCP. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the Agent/deep-research synthesis path. Community testing of the related Websets search-verify-enrich flow also reported stalled verification and failed enrichment fields.
